name: transcript
title_zh: 视频说了什么，它逐字给你，不添一句
tagline_zh: 不用开口要字幕，链接一贴它就自动扒口播稿。总结、引用、翻译、查证，凡是要看视频内容的活，它先帮你把字备齐。
tagline_en: Paste a link, get the verbatim transcript. Summarize, quote, translate, fact-check—it fetches the words first so.
desc_en: Use when the spoken content of a YouTube video is needed — even if not explicitly requested: pasted video links or IDs, requests to summarize, quote, transcribe, translate, fact-check, or extract anything from a video. Also use for research or learning when a video is the source. Not for uploads or account management.
why_zh: 它把「看视频」降维成「读文本」：转录先行，后续任何处理都有据可依。不猜你要什么，先把原料给足。
why_en: Turns watching into reading: transcript-first, so every downstream task has exact source text. No guessing, no rewatching.
limit_zh: 只认 YouTube 公开视频链接或 ID；不处理本地上传、会员专享、无字幕语言（需自动生成可用）。只输出文字稿。
limit_en: YouTube public links/IDs only; no uploads, member-only, or languages without auto-captions. Outputs raw transcript only—no summarization or.
title_en: Get the exact spoken words of any YouTube video
